name: Hamadryad Queen
body:
HAMADRYAD QUEEN
CR 30/MR 6

This imposing woman strides towards you with a majestic gait, her dress and hair stud with starry lights and nuanced with all the colours of a forest’s foliage in every season of the year.

XP 9,830,400
Hamadryad witch 20 (ley line guardian)
CG Medium fey
Init +13; Senses greensight, low-light vision; Perception +35

DEFENSE

AC 50, touch 24, flat-footed 40 (+8 armor, +4 deflection, +9 Dex, +1 dodge, +18 natural)
hp 418 (40d6+240+36); fast healing 5
Fort +20, Ref +27, Will +32
DR 10/cold iron and epic; Resist acid 30, cold 30, electricity 30

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +5 dagger +35/+30/+25/+20 (1d4+14/19–20)
Ranged +2 speed composite longbow +31/+31/+26/+21/+16 (1d8+11/×3)
Special Attacks hexes (ameliorating, aura of purity, charm, life giver, major ameliorating, protective luck, speak in dreams, witch’s charge; DC 29), grand hex, major hex, mythic power 10/day, surge 1d8, throw spell
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +29)

Constant—speak with animals, speak with plants
At will—entangle (DC 20), hold animal (DC 21), rusting grasp, tree shape, wood shape (10 lbs. only)
5/day—charm monster (DC 23), charm person (DC 20), confusion (DC 22), deep slumber (DC 22), neutralize poison, sending (dryads only), suggestion (DC 22), tree stride
1/day—align weapon (chaos), align weapon (good), analyze dweomer (DC 25), animate objects, antimagic field, arcane eye, blade barrier (DC 25), call lightning storm (DC 24), changestaff, chaos hammer (DC 23), dispel evil (DC 24), dispel law (DC 24), dispel magic, good hope, greater heroism, heal, heroes’ feast, hideous laughter (DC 21), holy smite (DC 23), identify, imbue with spell ability, irresistible dance (DC 25), liveoak, magic aura, magic circle against evil, magic circle against law, magic mouth, protection from evil, protection from law, spell resistance, summon nature’s ally VIII

Witch Spells Known (CL 20th; concentration +29)

9th Level (7/day)—ascension, dominate monster (DC 32), threefold form, wish MP (DC 28)
8th Level (7/day)—demand (DC 31), mass charm monster (DC 31), maze, prismatic wall P
(DC 27)
7th Level (7/day)—control weather, heal, limited wish P (DC 26), mass demanding message (DC 30)
6th Level (7/day)—cloak of dreams (DC 29), geas/quest M, globe of invulnerability P, legend lore
5th Level (8/day)—baleful polymorph (DC 24), break enchantment M, cure critical wounds, imbue hex, mage’s faithful hound P
4th Level (8/day)—cape of wasps M (butterflies), cure serious wounds, lesser globe of invulnerability P, threefold aspect, wandering star motes (DC 23)
3rd Level (8/day)—conjure carriage M, detect desires (DC 22), greater magic weapon P, share senses, spirit bonds
2nd Level (8/day)—apport object, arcane lock P, cure moderate wounds, enthrall M (DC 25), euphoric cloud (DC 21), illusory maze (DC 25)
1st Level (9/day)—alluring light (DC 24), beguiling gift (DC 24), command (DC 24), cure light wounds, magic missile P, sleep (DC 24)
0-Level (at will)—arcane mark, dancing lights, daze (DC 23), detect fiendish presence, detect magic, guidance, mending, message, read magic

Patron Arcana

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 28, Con 23, Int 22, Wis 23, Cha 28
Base Atk +20; CMB +22; CMD 41
Feats Alertness, Arcane Blast, Arcane Shield, Combat Casting, Dodge, Eschew Materials, Great Fortitude, Greater Spell Focus (enchantment), Improved Initiative, Improved Iron Will, Iron Will, Mounted Combat, Mythic Spell Lore M, Reactive Arcane Shield M, Spell Focus M (enchantment), Stealthy, Toughness, Vast Spell, Weapon Finesse M, Weapon Focus (dagger), Witch Knife
Skills Bluff +34, Climb +27, Craft (wood) +39, Diplomacy +34, Escape Artist +38, Handle Animal +31, Heal +32, Intimidate +34, Knowledge (arcana) +32, Knowledge (geography) +31, Knowledge (nature) +31, Knowledge (nobility) +28, Perception +35, Perform (sing) +34, Ride +31, Sense Motive +35, Spellcraft +31, Stealth +38, Survival +28; Racial Modifiers +8 Craft (wood)
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan; speak with animals, speak with plants, tongues
SQ conduit surge 12/day, crafting mastery, divine source x2 (Chaos/Revelry, Good, Magic/Arcane), druid magic, ley line powered, mythic immortality, plantbringer, tree meld, wild empathy, witch’s dance, woodcraft

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Conduit Surge (Su)

At 1st level, a ley line guardian is adept at channeling energy from ley lines to enhance her own spells. As a swift action, she can increase her effective caster level for the next spell she casts in that round by 1d4–1 levels. After performing a conduit surge, the ley line guardian must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + level of spell cast + number of additional caster levels granted) or become staggered for a number of minutes equal to the level of the spell cast. At 8th level, the caster level increase becomes 1d4. She can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Charisma modifier. This ability replaces familiar and the hexes gained at 1st and 8th levels.

Druid Magic (Su)

A hamadryad can use any magic item as if she were a 20th-level druid.

Ley Line Powered

Instead of preparing her spells, a ley line guardian draws the power casting spells directly from ley lines. A ley line guardian is a spontaneous spellcaster. She knows the same number of spells and receives the same number of spell slots per day as a sorcerer of her witch level. Bonus spells granted by a ley line guardian’s patron are added to the ley line guardian’s total spells known at the appropriate levels. This ability alters the witch’s spellcasting.

Tree Meld (Su)

A hamadryad can meld with any tree (similar to meld into stone) and can remain melded with a tree as long as she wishes.

Woodcraft (Ex)

A hamadryad has a +8 racial bonus on Craft checks involving wood, and is always treated as if she had masterwork artisan’s woodworking tools when attempting such checks.

ECOLOGY

Environment any forests
Organization retinue (1 plus 2–12 dryads) or court (1 plus 2–20 centaurs, 2–20 dryads, 1-2 hamadryads/erlkings, 2–16 satyrs, and 1–6 treants)
Treasure triple (dryad’s song, +5 dagger, +2 speed composite longbow, bracers of armor +8, laurel of command, ring of protection +4, other treasure)
